notes: Curated core of the Mojo standard library: the builtin types (Bool, Int/Float/String literals, Tuple, Range, DType, Variadics, sort, slices, enums, float formatting) and the collections (Dict, List, Set, Deque, Optional, Span, Array, Interval, Counter, LinkedList, BitSet, String and its format/codepoint/iterator helpers). Left out for the ~1.2M budget and covered in mojo_stdlib_systems.txt instead: math, memory, algorithm, SIMD, traits, iterators, utils, os/sys, time, random, hash, complex. Also left out: collections/string/_unicode_lookups.mojo (228,011 chars of lookup tables, no teaching value), string/_grapheme_break* and _parsing_numbers internals, builtin/_coroutine.mojo, and the stdlib test suite (384 test files, mostly assertions). Code unmodified, joined with '--- SOURCE: <repo path> ---' separators.
